statutory_provisions: IPC s.120-B, 420, 467, 468, 471, 477-A and 201 r/w ss. 13(1)(d) and 13(2) of Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988
neutral_facts: The prosecution alleged that a fictitious bank account was opened without proper verification, and a sum of money was deposited and subsequently withdrawn through forged cheques. The accused were bank employees who had access to banking records and procedures. Evidence suggested their involvement in the fraudulent activities, including the creation of forged entries and the use of forged signatures. Handwriting expert testimony was presented to link the accused to the fraudulent documents. The investigation did not fully uncover all the individuals involved in the embezzlement, but the evidence against the accused was deemed sufficient to establish their involvement in the conspiracy.
